author: rApq
content:
ADVERSARIAL REVIEW (inline — the dispatched acto-critic subagents died on a spend limit, so I ran the highest-value soundness probes directly). RESULTS:

CLEAN (verified):
- Fragment-support refusal is AIRTIGHT: render_term handles only Add/Sub/Mul, render_prop only comparisons+And/Or/Not; Div/Rem/Shl/Shr/BitAnd/BitOr/BitXor → SmtExportError. Any unsupported subterm fails the whole goal (? propagation), so a mixed (a+b)==(c^d) clause correctly STAYS solver, not migrated. (closes dim 2)
- bitvector.rs SMT render ops all CORRECT: unsigned compares (bvult/bvule/bvugt/bvuge, not signed), logical shifts (bvlshr), bvand/bvor/bvxor, overflow preds textbook. (closes dim 6)
- Multiplication (bv8 AND bv64) discharges axiom-clean [propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound] via the bounded-int model — cvc5 reconstructs the ring identity symbolically, no sorryAx despite the upstream Bitblast sorry in the graph. (closes the dim-1 mul concern)
- Faithfulness chain kernel-proven (BvModel frmInt_iff_frmBV/tv_equiv_faithful axiom-clean); residual = the two string-emission legs (#356), honestly named.
- Timeout/Unknown held distinct from Proved by construction (BvOutcome).
- req IS threaded (REQ-5 add_bounded-vs-add_overflows proves it).

FINDING (anti-Goodhart gap, ELEVATED by the trust flip) — pinned by failing tests in forge/tests/adv_locks.rs:
The bv route runs NO vacuity detection. The v1 cage rejects req-unsatisfiable as VacuousPrecondition (RFC §10), but bv_fn_cert/bv_lemma_cert only thread req into discharge_bv. A result-referencing req-false clause is incidentally caught by the mutation gate (WeakContract), BUT a PARAM-ONLY @bv clause or a @bv LEMMA (no body→no mutation) certifies L4 with a KERNEL-CHECKED trust label on a vacuous proof, cert even records vacuous_precondition:false. The bv route NEWLY permits param-only ens (mix64's lemma needs it) and opened a vacuity path it never guarded. Recommend FIXING before accepting the trust flip: bv route should assert req-SAT (req alone satisfiable; UNSAT→VacuousPrecondition reject) before discharging, mirroring the v1 check.
